q: with the Rabb of the morning
v.s: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak
v.c: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “I seek refuge in the Lord of the daybreak

q: “...from the evil of what He has created...”
v.s: From the evil of that which He created
v.c: from the evil of whatever He has created,

q: (of error, sin and distress whether internal or external)
(with the many evil forces to carry out their evil)...”
v.s: And from the evil of darkness when it settles
v.c: and from the evil of the night when it grows dark,

v.s: And from the evil of the blowers in knots
v.c: and from the evil of those ˹witches casting spells by˺ blowing onto knots,

q: ...and from the mischief of the person who envies when he envies
(the jealous person) who does things such as black magic to harm others).
v.s: And from the evil of an envier when he envies."
v.c: and from the evil of an envier when they envy.”
